turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We need new photos for our bakery's menu board and I'm not sure how to do it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could just shoot them myself on my phone near the front window in the morning light.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew has a nice camera and offered to do it for a cake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a food photographer in the next town who charges a flat fee for half a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we skip photos and use hand drawn illustrations of the bread and pastries.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Illustrations would give the bakery real character and never look dated. If you want photos, start with your phone, and only call the food photographer if the results look flat.
